description: PROP-005/006 (verification-architecture.md:27-28) call for 'a fake post_reel.py stub that prints each of the 3 outcome JSONs in turn' but never specify the stub's exact JSON key/value shape. The REAL post_reel.py today (post_reel.py:87, 182-183) only ever emits `reached` (a string state name like 'PUBLISHED'/'shared-unconfirmed'/'no-share-btn'/etc.), `published` (bool), `post_url`, and sometimes `error` — it NEVER emits the literal strings 'published'/'unverified'/'failed' anywhere. REQ-004's 3-outcome vocabulary has no defined mapping to/from this real schema (e.g., does 'failed' correspond to reached=='no-share-btn' AND to the account-guard abort AND to the file-chooser-load failure, all three of which are structurally different early-return branches in post_reel.py?). Without this mapping and a named output key, the PROP-005 stub's 'exact JSON output shape' is unspecified — the integration test cannot be written without the test author inventing the schema, which is precisely the judgment call a Tier-2 proof obligation should not leave open.
